forbidden_use: direct family delivery without clinician approval
source_title: SCCM Guidelines on Recognizing and Responding to Clinical Deterioration Outside the ICU
topic: Including patient and family concerns in escalation
clinical_context: Use to draft clinician-reviewed language acknowledging family observations about deterioration.
key_points: The guideline suggests incorporating patient, family, and care partner concerns into decisions to obtain additional help.
Family concerns should be heard and addressed by the healthcare team.
family_friendly_language: We will make sure your concerns are shared with the clinical team for review.
professional_preview_language: Family/care partner concern noted; consider whether additional bedside review is indicated.
